facts.material: acrylic paints (five pods), paint brushes, clear acrylic plastic sheet, printed paper sheet, wooden stand
facts.function: craft activity: painting a printed image onto an acrylic sheet and displaying it
facts.form: retail kit of different articles put up together, ready for sale to users

gri_path: GRI 1: the components fall in different headings (3213 paints, 9603 brushes, 3920/3926 acrylic sheet, 4911 printed paper, 4420 wooden stand); no single heading covers the kit
GRI 3(a): each heading covers only part of the set, so they are equally specific
GRI 3(b): retail set (different articles, one activity, put up for retail sale); the acrylic paints give the essential character because they are indispensable to the painting activity

rejected_alternatives.reason: paints are put up as a set, so 3213.10 colors in sets applies
an adult/all-ages craft painting kit is not a toy; essential character from the paints
brushes are subsidiary to the paints
acrylic sheet is the painting surface but the paints give the kit its character

classification.rationale: The kit is a GRI 3(b) retail set: different articles classifiable in different headings, put up together for one painting activity and sold at retail. CBP consistently finds the paints give essential character to such painting kits because they are indispensable to the activity, as in NY N347383 (Painting Art Kit, 3213.10.0000). The kit is therefore classified as artists' colors in sets, 3213.10.00.00.
